extracted.intended_audience: inventors, applicants and patent practitioners seeking protection via the Eurasian (EAPO) patent system
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and substantive requirements and options for filing, examination, grant, post-grant actions, and fee payment for obtaining and maintaining a Eurasian patent under the Eurasian Patent Convention (EAPC) through the Eurasian Patent Office (EAPO).

rubrics_metrics.name: Single Eurasian application for coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: To obtain a Eurasian patent with validity in all the Convention’s States party to the Convention ONE Eurasian application is filed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A single Eurasian application is filed to protect an invention across the Contracting States; this yields one Eurasian patent valid in the territory of the Convention's States party.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language and translation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Eurasian application can be filed in ANY language with further submission of translation into Russian.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants may file initially in any language but must submit a Russian translation subsequently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Basis on PCT international application
rubrics_metrics.description: Eurasian patent may be obtained on the basis of an INTERNATIONAL application filed under PCT procedure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An international (PCT) application can serve as the basis for obtaining a Eurasian patent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patentability criteria correspondence
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria of patentability under Eurasian legislation CORRESPOND to PCT Regulations, European Patent Convention (EPC) and to legislation of the world developed countries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Substantive patentability standards align with widely used international frameworks (PCT, EPC, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Permitted filing formats
rubrics_metrics.description: Eurasian application may be filed both in paper and in ELECTRONIC form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants have the option to submit their applications either on paper or electronically.

rubrics_metrics.name: EAPO role under PCT and similarity of requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: EAPO may be a RECEIVING, a DESIGNATED and an ELECTED office under the PCT. Requirements as to preparation and content of a Eurasian application are similar to those of PCT, PLT, and EPC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preparation/content expectations mirror PCT, PLT and EPC standards; EAPO can act in multiple PCT office capacities.

rubrics_metrics.name: International-type search and substantive examination by EAPO
rubrics_metrics.description: EAPO conducts patent search of the international type and substantive examination which prove RELIABILITY of the Eurasian patent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EAPO carries out both international-type searches and substantive examination to assess patentability and ensure the patent's reliability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limit to request substantive examination
rubrics_metrics.description: The applicant may submit a request for substantive examination within a SIX-MONTH term from the date of publication of the search report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must file the substantive examination request within six months following publication of the search report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extensions and accelerated processing option
rubrics_metrics.description: At the request of the applicant: Time limits for the grant of a Eurasian patent MAY BE EXTENDED; and ACCELERATED processing at all stages may be provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants can request extensions of time limits and may obtain accelerated processing for one or more stages upon request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection of Contracting Parties for post-grant maintenance
rubrics_metrics.description: CHOOSE EAPC Contracting parties where a Eurasian patent shall be maintained;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After grant, the patent holder selects which Contracting States the Eurasian patent will be maintained in (i.e., national validation/maintenance choices).

rubrics_metrics.name: Restoration of rights lapsed for non-payment
rubrics_metrics.description: RESTORE rights in a Eurasian patent lapsed as a result of non-payment of a maintenance fee;
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There exists a procedure to restore rights if they lapsed due to missed maintenance fee payments (subject to applicable rules and conditions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent term extension for certain categories
rubrics_metrics.description: EXTEND term of validity of a Eurasian patent in respect of certain categories of inventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For specific categories of inventions, an extension of the patent term may be available under the applicable rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fee rule for applicants from EAPC contracting states
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants from the EAPC contacting states PAY 10% of all fees for legally relevant actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statement indicates a fee-related rule applying to applicants from Contracting States (verbatim wording from the source); consult EAPO for exact interpretation and application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing fee reductions based on search reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Filing fee is REDUCED by 25% if the application contains an international search report or a search report of the international type prepared by one of the international search authorities and by 40% if such reports were prepared by the Rospatent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presence of an international-type search report reduces filing fees: 25% reduction for reports from international authorities; 40% reduction for reports prepared by Rospatent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost advantage over national filings
rubrics_metrics.description: Costs for obtaining a Eurasian patent valid in several countries of the Eurasian region are LOWER than cumulative costs for obtaining national patents in those countries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Using the Eurasian route is presented as a cost-effective alternative versus filing separate national applications across the region.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusive rights from publication until first maintenance fee
rubrics_metrics.description: From publication of a Eurasian patent until payment of the first annual maintenance fee the patent holder has an exclusive right to his invention in ALL COUNTRIES of the region.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exclusive rights commence at publication and continue until the first annual maintenance fee is due/paid — covering all Contracting States until that first maintenance payment point.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment of fees to a single office, stage-to-stage
rubrics_metrics.description: Fees related to obtaining and maintenance of a Eurasian patent are payable to ONE office – EAPO. Fees are paid from STAGE-TO-STAGE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All procedural and maintenance fees are paid centrally to EAPO, and fees are paid progressively by stage rather than upfront for each national validation.
